patthana16.37:1.1: parittārammaṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na parittārammaṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana16.37:2.1: parittārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na mahaggatārammaṇo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: hetuyā nava. hīnattika hetuduke nahīnattika nahetudukaṃ
